Whether ratioPartsPerMillion (schedule_outcome.go:115-119) can render '+Inf' for extreme but contract-valid ratios (predicted makespan up to 2^1023 seconds against a realized makespan as small as 1e-9 seconds); not exercised by any committed test.

Whether the stored evaluator evidence under docs/operations/evidence/evaluators/2026-08-08/store replays byte-identically under this tree's code (NewEvaluatorRun/NewEvaluatorBatch canonicalization and validation); manual schema, sorting, and ID review indicates compatibility, but no executable gate (go test or record-evaluators round-trip) could be run in this read-only evaluation.

findings.summary: AssessValueScenarios uses nil-slice sentinels (alternativeIDs == nil at line 50, firstFrontier == nil at line 60) to detect the first scenario, and append([]string(nil), ...) of an empty slice stays nil, so a leading scenario with zero alternatives bypasses the inventory-change guard and a leading scenario with an empty Pareto frontier (all alternatives infeasible or missing evidence) suppresses FrontierChanges for the first actual change, contradicting the documented guarantee that inventory changes are rejected and frontier changes are reported.
evidence: Reproduction: probe AssessValueScenarios(criteria, []ValueScenario{{ID:"s1",Source:"s",SourceRevision:"r",Alternatives:nil},{ID:"s2",Source:"s",SourceRevision:"r",Alternatives:[oneValidAlternative]}}) returns nil error and FrontierChanges=false; no committed test covers an empty leading scenario (missing gate in value_scenario_test.go)

value_scenario.go:50-53 and 60-63: append of an empty ids/frontier slice to []string(nil) yields nil, so the second scenario is treated as 'first' again; AssessValue(criteria, nil) returns an empty assessment without error, making the bypass reachable

findings.summary: AssessExperiment initializes PrimaryPassed and GuardrailsPassed to true and only clears them when evaluating an effect that is present, so an outcome that omits the primary metric's effect yields a decision JSON with primaryPassed:true (eligible stays false only because reasons is non-empty); the boolean does not mean the primary hypothesis was proven, which is the same missing-evidence-reads-as-healthy shape the subsystem elsewhere rejects.
evidence: Reproduction: probe AssessExperiment with a valid plan (primary metric 'm') and an outcome with Effects:[] returns ExperimentDecision{PrimaryPassed:true, GuardrailsPassed:true, Eligible:false}; missing gate: experiment_test.go never asserts the flags when an effect is absent

experiment.go:103 sets both flags true; the loop at lines 104-138 only touches flags for seen effects; lines 139-143 append 'missing effect' to Reasons without clearing the corresponding flag; line 145 gates Eligible on len(Reasons)==0

findings.summary: Recommend never checks its now argument against request.Snapshot.CapturedAt, so it constructs and returns a Recommendation that VerifyRecommendation then rejects with 'recommendation predates its snapshot' (evidence.go:107-109); the constructor emits artifacts that fail the temporal invariant its own verifier enforces instead of failing closed.
evidence: Reproduction: probe Recommend(validRequestWithCapturedAtT, now=T-1s) returns a non-error Recommendation, then VerifyRecommendation on the result returns the 'predates its snapshot' error; missing gate: evidence_test.go has no construction-time temporal test

evidence.go:72-91 (Recommend) contains no created-vs-captured comparison while evidence.go:107-109 (VerifyRecommendation) rejects created.Before(captured); cmd/platform-optimizer passes time.Now() so the gap is only reachable through the library path

findings.summary: validateRecommendationRequest rejects constraint evidence whose ObservedAt is newer than the snapshot ('constraint %q is newer than snapshot') but applies no analogous check to Problem.CostModel.AsOf, so a recommendation ID can commit to price evidence that postdates the pinned state snapshot while all other time-bearing evidence is gated against it.
evidence: Reproduction: probe Recommend with Snapshot.CapturedAt=2026-08-08T00:00:00Z and CostModel.AsOf=2026-08-09T00:00:00Z is accepted; missing gate: no test asserts cost-model/snapshot temporal ordering

evidence.go:155-161 compares only constraint ObservedAt to captured; CostModel.AsOf is validated solely as RFC3339 in scheduler.go:209-211 with no snapshot-time comparison; MeasureCostAccuracy later requires observedAt >= modelAsOf (cost_outcome.go:65-68) showing the model's asOf is treated as a meaningful time elsewhere

findings.summary: FileValueAssessmentStore.Get decodes stored records with json.Unmarshal, which silently drops unknown JSON fields, while FileTwinStore.get (used for twin facts/snapshots and, via embedding, every evaluator run/batch/resolution) sets DisallowUnknownFields; an unknown field appended to a stored value assessment is therefore silently ignored on load instead of failing closed, an asymmetry in the immutable-evidence read path.
evidence: Reproduction: save a valid record, rewrite its file with an extra top-level field, then FileValueAssessmentStore.Get succeeds where FileTwinStore.GetSnapshot would fail; missing gate: value_store_test.go tests byte tampering but not unknown-field tolerance

value_store.go:166-169 uses plain json.Unmarshal; twin_store.go:114-116 uses json.Decoder with DisallowUnknownFields; the record ID covers only known fields (valueRecordID, value_store.go:84-97), so appended unknown bytes do not disturb verification

findings.summary: Solve's doubling loop returns 'optimization makespan overflow' as soon as hi reaches +Inf, rejecting problems whose true relaxed makespan lies in (2^1023, MaxFloat64] even though validate() admits any finite positive demand/capacity and feasible() would succeed at hi=MaxFloat64 (an Inf resource-edge capacity is harmless because source-to-item edges bound the flow).
evidence: Reproduction: probe Solve(Problem{Items:[]WorkItem{{ID:"x",Demand:1.5e308}},Resources:[]Resource{{ID:"r",Capacity:1}}}) returns the overflow error although the makespan 1.5e308 is representable; missing gate: scheduler_test.go covers tiny/huge scale ratios (1e-12..1e15) but not makespans above 2^1023
scheduler.go:99-105 doubles hi from 1.0 and errors on IsInf without first clamping to math.MaxFloat64 and testing feasibility there; scheduler.go:149-150 admits demands up to MaxFloat64

findings.summary: normalize-evaluator-receipts.mjs hard-codes modelVersion 'cursor-agent@2026.08.04-aaa8809' into every normalized EvaluatorRun rather than measuring the installed agent version (e.g. from the receipt or cursor-agent --version), so the version provenance that validateEvaluatorRun requires and that is hashed into each content-addressed run ID is asserted by the script author, not evidenced, and silently misstates the agent if a different build produced the findings.
evidence: Missing gate: no check compares the recorded modelVersion against the actual cursor-agent build; a version field in the receipt schema is not visible anywhere in this tree

scripts/normalize-evaluator-receipts.mjs:55 emits the same literal modelVersion for all three model families; the mock receipt in scripts/test-evaluator-runner.sh:25 contains no version field and run-evaluator-batch.sh never records cursor-agent --version into the evidence directory; evaluator.go:183-185 requires ModelVersion non-empty and evaluator.go:160 hashes it into the run ID
